product_metadata.title: BigOtters 100PCS Large Artificial Acorns, 1.5 X 0.8 Inches Mixed Color Fake Nutty with Natural Acorn Cap Simulation Fruit Props for Home Autumn Decor Craft DIY Wedding Festival Party Favor
features: PACKAGE INCLUDED - 100 X Artificial Acorn, with 2 different colors: dark brown and light brown, every 50pcs acorns in one perticular color. (Basket is not included)

BIG - Unlike normal acorns, our craft acorns have a larger size. 0.8 in diameter and 1.5 in height, weighs about 3g. Perfect decoration for photo prop, Autumn theme party, Thanksgiving dinner table and Christmas wreath. Can add a pop of fall atmosphere to your home.

PREMIUM QUALITY -The body part of our big acorn is made of high-grade Polystyrene foam and the cap part is from natural acorn, realistic and vivid, well finish and smooth, non-toxic and odorless, passed a rigorous testing and certification process, 100% safe to use.
DIY SUPPLIES - Our craft acorns are perfect for DIY project. You can pair them with pine core, maple leaves, pumpkin and candles to decorate your dinner table, garden, hat, wreath, bedroom, etc.

WIDE APPLICATIONS - Our artificial acorns are perfect decorations for Christmas, Thanksgiving, Halloween, any kind of parties, weddings .Ideal display ornaments for kitchen, garden, house, fruit shop, bakery, etc. Great as vase filler.
